impact_title: How your support helps the mission
impact_sub: Everything Christian Culture produces exists to share the Gospel without paywalls. We describe real areas of activity without unverified counters or estimates.
impact_1_d: Keeping online radio broadcasts, streaming servers and production workflows running continuously for listeners and viewers.
impact_2_d: Preparing daily devotional lessons, Scripture recordings and free educational courses accessible without registration fees.
impact_3_d: Maintaining free Android/web applications, the LUMINA community portal and open tools for everyday engagement with Scripture.

faq_1_q: Do I have to pay or donate to use Christian Culture content?
faq_1_a: No. Radio, television, Audio Bible, Academy lessons, apps and daily devotionals are completely free for everyone. All support is voluntary.
faq_2_q: Can I help without giving money?
faq_2_a: Yes — prayer, sharing broadcasts, volunteering, ministry partnership and technical/equipment support are equally valued ways to help.
faq_3_a: BLIK phone transfers work exclusively inside Polish banking apps. Beneficiary: Cezary Rogowski. This page never requests BLIK codes or bank credentials.
faq_4_q: What is the difference between Patronite and bank/Revolut transfers?
faq_4_a: Patronite supports ongoing monthly patronage, whereas PLN bank transfers, BLIK and Revolut are intended for one-time voluntary gifts without auto-billing.
faq_5_q: Who receives transfers, and is this affiliated with Polskie Radio S.A.?
faq_5_a: The beneficiary is Cezary Rogowski. Christian Culture is an independent private Christian initiative and is not connected with Polskie Radio S.A.
faq_6_q: Are gifts tax-deductible or automatically confirmed?
faq_6_a: No tax deductions or statutory status are promised, and clicking buttons here does not verify a payment. Public thanks require explicit, revocable consent.
